project.name: llmgw-approval
project.description: Approval workflow subsystem (Chapter-9 9.5.4): pending → approved / rejected / expired / revoked state machine for high-risk tool or model operations. Approval never auto-grants execution — callers revalidate the subject, params digest, expiry and state right before executing; decisions are durable CAS transitions so concurrent or repeated callbacks decide once. Approval timeout does NOT degrade execution to read-only; a rejection never implicitly substitutes tools or params.
